editionLabel: English rules distributed by R&R Games
firstPlayerRule: The player most eager to get married starts; the rules alternatively suggest whoever got married most recently.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: These are alternative starting criteria, not a stated tie-break sequence. The starter receives no setup bonus and takes the first turn moving the shared heroes' group; play then continues clockwise.
